dedupe_keys.name: china city level building operating carbon emissions 2015 2020

description: The China building-emissions team publishes a city-level building operational carbon workbook through Figshare under CC0. The article describes 321 cities from 2015 to 2020, with totals split by building type, energy activity and six end-use groups such as heating, cooling and lighting. The workbook has 12 year-specific worksheets. These estimates can provide demand or emissions benchmarks when calibrating urban building-energy scenarios. A caveat is that the values are modelled from top-down and bottom-up inputs, not direct meter readings at each building, and some city electricity values were filled where source data were missing. The separate uncertainty workbook has its own Figshare DOI. Users should keep the 10,000-ton CO2 unit and original category definitions when mapping values to simulations. I read the own Figshare metadata and article Data Records without downloading Excel files, recomputing emissions or checking city estimates. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
